description: Jump to any directory you have been in before
detail: zoxide ranks by how often and how recently you go there, so `z dot` lands in ~/.dotfiles from anywhere.

description: Same as z, but pick from a list when several match
Typing a directory name on its own is enough to cd into it
detail: AUTO_CD is on, so `..` and `../..` work as commands too.

description: Back to the directory you were in before
detail: `cd -<Tab>` shows the whole stack of recent directories to pick from.

description: Fuzzy find a directory below here and cd into it
Create a directory and step into it
Jump to .dotfiles, development, Documents, Downloads
Drop a file path into the command you are typing
detail: Preview shows the file with highlighting. Ctrl+/ moves the preview around.

description: Fuzzy search your shell history
detail: Beats pressing Up thirty times.

description: cd into a directory picked from a list
detail: On this Mac it is also bound to the ç that Alt+c actually produces.

description: Fuzzy complete the argument to any command
detail: Works everywhere: `nvim **<Tab>`, `kill -9 **<Tab>`, `git checkout **<Tab>`.

description: Search history and run the chosen command immediately
detail: Ctrl+r only puts it on the line, this runs it.

description: Mark several results at once in a multi-select picker
detail: Used by gafzf, grmfzf and friends.

description: A leading space keeps a command out of history
detail: For anything with a token or a password in it.

description: Every open shell sees the same history, live
detail: 50,000 entries, timestamped, duplicates dropped.

description: Leave insert mode on the command line
detail: The cursor changes to a block, so you can always see which mode you are in.

description: Open the command you are typing in neovim, save to run it
detail: The best way to fix a long or multi-line command.

description: Yank to the macOS clipboard, not just the shell buffer
Jump to the start or end of the line
detail: Kept from emacs mode. Ctrl+k still kills to the end of the line.

description: Accept the greyed-out suggestion
detail: It comes from your history first, then from completion.

description: Turn the completion list into a menu you can arrow around
detail: Matching ignores case, so `cd doc` completes `Documents`.

description: Restart zsh in place after changing a config file
Machine-specific settings go here
detail: ~/.config/zsh/local.zsh is git-ignored and loads last, so it overrides anything before it.

description: Employer or client settings go here
detail: Also git-ignored. Secrets belong in ~/.env, which .zshenv picks up.

description: Add to PATH with path_prepend
detail: It skips directories that do not exist and refuses to add anything twice.

description: Unpack any archive without remembering the flags
detail: tar, gz, xz, bz2, zip, 7z, rar.

description: Open the yazi file manager, and land in whatever directory you left it in
Print PATH one entry per line
Keep the Mac awake, lid closed included
detail: Ctrl+c turns sleep back on.

description: Measure how long a new shell takes to start
detail: Currently around 100ms. Run it a few times, the first is always slower.
